purpose: Registry of candidate external scientific resources. This registry is metadata only; it does not mean their datasets have been downloaded or validated by Virtual Lab.

sources.name: BioModels
sources.access: public website and programmatic access options
sources.license_policy: Check the specific model record and current repository terms before importing. Historical BioModels records commonly use CC0, but do not assume this for every resource without checking.
sources.planned_integration: Model discovery, metadata capture, SBML/model file import, provenance and reproducibility checks
sources.verification_status: source identified; no model files imported yet

sources.name: SBML Test Suite
sources.resource_type: model conformance tests and expected simulation results
sources.license_policy: The suite is distributed under LGPL v2.1 with components potentially under other open-source terms; review the exact release and file notices before redistribution.
sources.planned_integration: Import test cases and compare compatible solver outputs to expected results
sources.verification_status: source identified; no test case archives imported yet

sources.name: Simulation Experiment Description Markup Language (SED-ML)

sources.license_policy: Review license notices for the exact specification/repository version used.
sources.planned_integration: Represent model, simulation settings, tasks and outputs in portable experiment descriptions
